mechanism.claim: A nonlinear classifier fitted only on pre-2023 high-range-volatility hourly states can isolate directional twelve-hour continuations and reversals. Extreme calibrated class probabilities should retain edge when the same high-volatility state recurs.
mechanism.side: upper calibrated probability tail long; lower tail short
mechanism.why_distinct: HVHGC uses an hourly 12-hour binary target and fits only high-volatility rows. HVGBR used six-hour anchors, a 72-hour continuous target, and all fit states; HVETCR used ExtraTrees and a 48-hour target. No prior fitted artifact, threshold, event, control, or OOS result is reused.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: probability-tail events are model-state-dependent hourly clocks rather than Gross9's fixed structural schedules

training_contract.anchors: each completed xx:55 UTC bar; entry is next exact-hour open
training_contract.label: one iff log(open at entry+144 bars/open at entry)>0, else zero
training_contract.fit_volatility: range_vol >= source-only q60 across complete fit anchors; classifier is fitted only on those high-volatility fit rows
training_contract.imputer: SimpleImputer(strategy='median') fitted only on eligible fit rows
training_contract.calibration_probability: q10 and q90 of predictions on all complete 2023H1 calibration anchors; calibration labels and post-entry prices remain unopened
training_contract.calibration_volatility: source-only q60 range_vol on calibration anchors

oos_clock.decision: each completed xx:55 UTC bar from 2023-07-01 onward
oos_clock.eligibility: range_vol>=frozen calibration q60 and probability<=q10 or >=q90; first true row of a consecutive same-tail run only
oos_clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.historical: hash-bound market, funding, and premium sources
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: freeze registration, fit pre-2023 high-volatility labels, calibrate 2023H1 sources only, freeze model, then open OOS incidence; terminal first failure without model, threshold, probability-tail, hold, or direction repair
